notes.title: Update 1.1 is coming soon!
notes.content:
Greetings,

Update 1.1 for Alter World will be coming soon. Here's list of the changes we've made to the game:

1) Level Select - You will now be able to replay any kind of level.
2) Added Chinese localization (Both Traditional and Simplified)
3) Added Steam Controller support
4) Minor tweaks

This update will be deployed in the upcoming hours.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Alter World
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/357280]Alter World[/url] is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

The Game is inspired by Stephen King’s book - “The Dark Tower”. The game is a 2D platformer with a interesting gameplay mechanic. Playercan pass on an alternative universe anytime and use an alternative universe reality to move to another level. Levels are unique, with puzzles, and the player will have to react quickly and assess when to move between the Worlds. The game is made in a unique, art style, like a painting. 

*Offer ends June 5 at 10AM Pacific Time
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/357280/header.jpg[/img]
